description: Canonical MACD golden vector (12/26/9): 60 closes — 30 flat at 100.0 (seeds both EMAs to 100), then +2.0 per candle for 30 candles (rising trend). Fast EMA (12) responds quicker than slow EMA (26), generating positive MACD line throughout the ramp. Output length = 60-26-9+2 = 27 triples. First triple verified by step-through computation: fast EMA seeds diverge after close[26] departure from flat. Cross-verified with Go implementation.

input.closes_description: 60 closes — 30 flat at 100, then +2/candle ramp to 160

invariants.note: Rising trend forces fastEMA above slowEMA throughout. MACD and histogram both positive for all 27 triples.
